name: Enthralling
text:
Aspect artistry

Activate 2 concentrate

Frequency once per day

---

Effect You speak at length about or demonstrate your craft, or you enact a performance. The relic casts Enthrall at a level equal to half its own. If you have legendary proficiency in Crafting or Performance, creatures can't critically succeed on their saves against this spell. You can Sustain the activation to sustain the effect as you would the spell.
